messages.content: Hi, this is Kumar from Pharmaniaga IT procurement. Customer ID cust-phma-corp-22. We need a SASE solution — 12 branches, deployment profile cloud-delivered with ZTNA. Can you help me search available offers?
Good morning, Sir Kumar. Searching SASE offers matching your profile now.

messages.name: search_sase_offers
messages.content: {"offers": [{"offer_id": "offer-sase-biz-360", "name": "SASE Business 360", "capabilities": ["ztna", "swg", "casb", "fwaas", "dlp"], "sla_pct": 99.95, "price_per_user_monthly_myr": 65}, {"offer_id": "offer-sase-plus", "name": "SASE Plus", "capabilities": ["ztna", "swg", "casb", "fwaas"], "sla_pct": 99.9, "price_per_user_monthly_myr": 48}, {"offer_id": "offer-sase-edge", "name": "SASE Edge", "capabilities": ["ztna", "swg"], "sla_pct": 99.5, "price_per_user_monthly_myr": 32}], "total": 3}

Sir, 3 offers fit your scope:

| Offer | Capabilities | SLA | Per-user/month |
|---|---|---|---|
| SASE Business 360 | ZTNA+SWG+CASB+FWaaS+DLP | 99.95% | RM 65 |
| SASE Plus | ZTNA+SWG+CASB+FWaaS | 99.9% | RM 48 |
| SASE Edge | ZTNA+SWG | 99.5% | RM 32 |

Shall I create a cart with SASE Business 360 to get a full quote for 480 users + 12 sites?
Yes, create cart and add Business 360. We'll need to configure the 12 sites too.
Creating the cart and adding the offer.

messages.name: create_sase_cart
messages.content: {"cart_id": "cart-phma-77019", "customer_id": "cust-phma-corp-22", "status": "open", "created_at": "2026-05-21T14:01:00+08:00"}
Cart `cart-phma-77019` created. Adding the SASE Business 360 offer now.

Item added; subtotal **RM 31,200/month**. Now let's configure the 12 sites and user groups.
Sites: 4 in KL, 3 in Selangor (Shah Alam, Subang Jaya, Klang), 2 in Penang, 1 each in Johor, Sabah, Sarawak. Users: 380 office staff + 100 field reps with mobile profiles.
Configuring now.

All 12 sites and 480 users (split 380 office / 100 mobile) configured. Shall I validate and quote the cart, plus pull the SASE order history for context?
Yes both.

Sir, quote `quote-phma-44091` generated:

- **Monthly total (incl. SST 6%)**: RM 33,072
- **Annual**: RM 396,864
- One-time setup: RM 14,400
- Valid until 21 Jul 2026
- Validation: all PASS; this is your first SASE order with us.

Shall I accept the quote and create the order with your billing profile?
Yes accept. Billing profile bp-phma-corp-finance-main, order contact me, payment method credit_card on file.
Accepting the quote and creating the order now.

messages.name: accept_quote_and_create_order

Order `ord-phma-sase-99019` created in awaiting_payment status (one-time setup RM 14,400 due). Shall I process the payment with the credit card on file, and create a snapshot before provisioning?
Yes, process payment. Pastu also snapshot the order state. Card on file CC-PHMA-MAYBANK-EZ.

Sir, payment of **RM 14,400 paid**; receipt available. Order status now `paid_pending_provisioning`. Snapshot `snap-ord-99019` saved.

Shall I start the SASE provisioning workflow?
Yes please. Phased rollout — KL sites first (4), then Selangor (3), then Penang+East Coast/East MY (5).
Baik Sir, kicking off provisioning.

Provisioning job `prov-phma-77019` queued (3 phases, estimated completion 5 Jul 2026). Let me check order status now.

messages.name: get_sase_order_status
messages.content: {"order_id": "ord-phma-sase-99019", "status": "provisioning_scheduled", "current_phase": null, "phases": [{"phase_id": "phase_kl", "status": "scheduled", "starts_at": "2026-06-10T00:00:00+08:00"}, {"phase_id": "phase_selangor", "status": "pending"}, {"phase_id": "phase_rest", "status": "pending"}]}

Order is in `provisioning_scheduled`. KL phase will start 10 June.

Sir, before we close out, I'd like to set up:
1. Subscription to provisioning notifications for you, and
2. An internal request to add an enterprise discount rider since this is a sizable first SASE order.

Shall I proceed with both?
Yes. Notification via email, and approval to your sales lead for retroactive discount rider — say 8% on subsequent renewal years.

Sir:

- Email notifications subscription `sub-phma-44091` active.
- Discount rider approval `appr-disc-77019` raised to sales lead Encik Kogilan, due 23 May 2 PM.

Anything else, Sir Kumar?
Actually one issue — our director says we need to change phase_kl start date to 12 June, not 10 June, public holiday clash. Can you modify before activation?
Certainly, modifying the order now.

Phase KL start date is now 12 June 2026. Selangor and rest phases remain on schedule.

Shall I add an internal note on the order so Phamaniaga's IT team has full context, and pin a dashboard tile for monitoring?
Yes both. Add comment and pin tile.

Final recap, Sir Kumar:
- Quote -> order -> payment -> provisioning queued (KL 12 Jun, Selangor 17 Jun, rest 24 Jun)
- Snapshot saved; email notifications active; discount rider pending
- Dashboard tile live for tracking

Is there anything else, Sir?
No, that's it. Thanks for the smooth checkout.
You are most welcome, Sir Kumar. We will reach out 7 days before each phase. Have a wonderful day.
